title: Yellowed Tunisian Monkfish Skewers
description: A traditional Tunisian dish featuring monkfish, with a blend of herbal flavors and a unique presentation, this recipe is sure to impress, it is also ayurvedic rajasic friendly.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the monkfish pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the monkfish pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the fish is cooked through.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
To achieve the yellowed effect, brush the skewers with a little bit of olive oil and grill for an additional 2 minutes.
To shape the monkfish like nigiri, press the cooked fish into small oval shapes using your hands or a small mold.
